note: Independent rejudgment after the unparam edit to writeAVPProxyAuthenID (avp_compound.go), which drops the mandatory parameter and always writes the M-bit clear, as RFC 2661 Section 4.4.5 says: "The M-bit for this AVP MUST be set to 0." Every caller passed false, so the emitted bytes are unchanged. TestAVPCatalogRoundTrip changed only by dropping that false argument from its ProxyAuthenID case; it still writes every catalog AVP, reads it back and fails when FlagReserved is set on the written AVP, so the send clause stays pinned. The receive clause is unchanged: TestRFC2661ReservedAVPBitTreatedAsUnrecognized (ICRQ, M=0 ignored, M=1 one CDN) and TestUnrecognizedMandatoryAVPInHelloClearsTunnel (HELLO, M=1 clears the tunnel, M=0 changes nothing). Producer re-read: AVPIterator.Next sets FlagReserved|FlagUnrecognized. Discrimination records are unchanged. No test was run for this source-only rejudgment.
